name: Sevilla at Downtown Doral

stage_evidence.note: Topped off, completing vertical construction, reported 1 March 2026

description: Seven-storey rental building with a central garage on a 4.2-acre parcel within the 250-acre Downtown Doral community, at the corner of NW 53rd Street and NW 52nd Terrace. Delivered in two phases.
notes: Unit count: the City's own site-plan record states 412 multifamily units and Florida YIMBY stated 412 in June 2024 and July 2025, then 405 on topping off in March 2026. The City record carries no date, so the most recent dated report wins and 405 is stored; 412 is the earlier figure.

name: The Oasis at Doral
filing_type: Live Local Act administrative site plan
description: Mixed-use residential development of up to 623 units and approximately 301,591 sq ft of commercial and retail space, including 262,816 sq ft of existing office space. First phase of 229 apartments and about 64,000 sq ft of retail. At least 40 per cent of units designated workforce housing. The first project in Doral approved under the Live Local Act.
notes: A $58m construction loan closed in March 2026 but the lender is not named, and a loan closing is not a construction start, so the stage stays Approved. The buildings were originally proposed at 10 and 12 storeys; no current storey count is stated.

description: A three-phase redevelopment of the closed JCPenney and Sears boxes at Miami International Mall with close to 900 residential units in buildings of five and six storeys above grade.

name: Prime Square Doral
description: A 58,000 sq ft commercial condominium of three buildings on a 3.25-acre property near NW 74th Street and NW 102nd Avenue, with approximately 40,000 sq ft of retail and restaurant space and 18,000 sq ft of office space. Construction expected to begin in the first quarter of 2027.
notes: Stage is Permitting: the project is described as approaching final permitting, and Miami-Dade County's Plat Committee approved a resubmission in January 2026. Civil engineer is filled because the article names the full design team, which is the only circumstance in which that field is filled for this market.
